row.evidence: OneSignal's SSO docs say: 'Add and remove users from the Team Members page in the OneSignal dashboard. Provisioning and de-provisioning directly through your IdP is not currently supported.'
row.notes: Unchanged from June (none). SSO (SAML 2.0 or OIDC) is on Enterprise or with the Legal & Security package upgrade; users must still be invited (no JIT). Pricing is usage-based: Free $0, Growth from $19/mo month-to-month (MAU/sends), Professional and Enterprise custom annual contracts, so per-user fields are null. The Okta catalogue app is SWA only. Audit logs API (GET /organizations/{organization_id}/audit_logs) needs Enterprise with the audit-logs entitlement. No documented API for managing dashboard team members; OneSignal's REST 'users' endpoints manage messaging end users, not team members.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: SSO possible with the Legal & Security package upgrade.

roles.how: SSO: identity-provider groups can be mapped to OneSignal roles (not provisioning).

limitations.text: Provisioning and de-provisioning through the IdP is not supported; team members are added and removed manually in the dashboard.
SSO users must also be invited to the organization; IdP authentication alone does not grant access.

user_api.notes: OneSignal's REST API (organization section) covers apps, API keys and audit logs; no endpoints for managing dashboard team members were found in the documentation index.

endpoints.purpose: List audit logs (Enterprise, Organization API key)

okta.notes: Okta catalogue page marks only SWA as supported functionality (read from the page's checked items).
